summary: Iter98 — Commit 1 of Presence & Status feature (backend + data model). Verified all 5 new endpoints under /api/status/*, café-join/leave auto-clear hooks, DM auto-clear historical guard, index creation on member_status collection, and backward compatibility of all existing endpoints. 62 tests total across three suites all passed (12 local svc unit + 27 live HTTP + 23 regression). No frontend changes needed and none made.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 10,178 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Splitting into modules is overdue (not blocking Commit 1 but flagged for future refactor).
services/status/service.py is clean, well-documented, correctly enforces UTC-awareness via _as_aware(), and MONGO ObjectId is not leaked (uses {_id: 0} projection where needed). No issues.
Router properly returns 400 on invalid manual_status via ValueError → HTTPException. Scope enum enforced by Pydantic Query(pattern=...) → 422. Both correct.
Auto-clear hook in DM path (line 9167) and café-join hook (line 5004-5017) are wrapped in try/except so a status glitch cannot break message send or table join — good defensive posture.

list_looking correctly enforces: viewer exclusion, bidirectional block filter, Nearby Opt-In, suburb match, and manual_status_expires_at filter. Verified via unit tests 7 and live test test_looking_excludes_self.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_presence_status_live.py (created — comprehensive live HTTP test suite for Commit 1)
seed_data_creation: None. All test data is prefixed with 'test-' and cleaned up in fixtures. Live tests use the pre-existing member@friendplace.com.au account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Commit 1 backend is fully verified and stable. When Commit 2/3 add frontend consumers of these endpoints, run /app/backend/tests/test_presence_status_live.py again as a regression baseline. The one skip (find-friends path) is because I did not know the exact URL — E1 confirmed find-friends works elsewhere; this is not a Commit 1 regression. Verified indexes on member_status: user_id_1 (unique), manual_status_1_manual_status_set_at_-1 (partial), manual_status_expires_at_1, in_cafe_table_id_1 (partial) — all 4 documented ones present.
